answer: Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the willow queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier still earns. The gale index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 960 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the atlas. Bonded capital sits idle for 2 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
